title: City Council District 5
statement: Two things sit on my desk this week and I'm not separating them. The D3 Fruitvale briefing record for the Alternative Response Initiative gets executed and published — D3 families were promised they could read their own calls, and East Oakland's calls are already moving through this program, so our record gets filed alongside theirs. No expansion into a thing we cannot read the record of. And I'm filing written next dates on the D5 audit and the Baylight feasibility review, because 'we'll get to it' is how a neighborhood stops being able to trust the ladder it was handed. East Oakland's sentiment is on the floor this cycle and its crime index is running above the city's — that is not a reason to slow down, it is the reason to put dates on paper.
numberMoved: OARI Fruitvale briefing record published with the D5 record filed alongside; written next dates set for the D5 audit and Baylight feasibility review.
